[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Rybo''' was a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] at [[Foundry Four/Legends|Foundry Four]]. Rybo was the second-in-command of the [[Foundry Four security team/Legends|security team]], serving under [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Bellows (clone trooper)/Legends|Bellows]].<ref name="Friends Like These" />
